title: Architect / Draughtsperson
salary_note: No salary given on the careers page — page must say 'Competitive salary'.
experience: Previous experience in an architectural, technical drawing, or draughtsperson role
description_text:
Our client is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Architect / Draughtsperson to join their team in Malta. The successful candidate will be involved in preparing architectural drawings, developing design concepts, producing technical documentation, and supporting projects throughout their various stages.
 This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated professional with strong technical drawing skills and an interest in architectural design and construction.
 Key Responsibilities
 Prepare architectural drawings, plans, elevations, sections, and detailed construction drawings.
 Develop and modify technical drawings in accordance with project requirements and design specifications.
 Assist with the preparation of planning applications, permits, and other relevant documentation.
 Translate architectural concepts and sketches into accurate technical drawings.
 Coordinate with architects, engineers, contractors, and other project stakeholders.
 Review drawings and ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with relevant building regulations and standards.
 Make amendments to drawings following design changes, site requirements, or client feedback.
 Conduct site visits when required to assess project progress and verify measurements.
 Maintain organised records of drawings, revisions, and project documentation.
 Provide technical support throughout the design and construction stages of projects.
 Requirements
 Only candidates currently residing in Malta will be considered for this position. 
 Previous experience in an architectural, technical drawing, or draughtsperson role.
 A qualification in Architecture, Architectural Technology, or a related field would be considered an asset.
 Good knowledge of architectural design principles, construction methods, and building materials.
 Proficiency in AutoCAD is essential.
 Knowledge of Revit, SketchUp, or other architectural design software would be considered an advantage.
 Understanding of planning procedures and local building regulations in Malta.
 Strong technical drawing and interpretation skills.
 Excellent attention to detail and organisational abilities.
 Ability to manage deadlines and work independently as well as within a team.
 Good communication and coordination skills.
 What Our Client Offers
 Opportunity to work on a variety of architectural and construction projects.
 Professional development and opportunities to expand technical skills.
 A collaborative and professional working environment.
 The opportunity to develop your career within the architecture and construction industry.
 If you have a passion for architecture, strong technical drawing skills, and are looking for your next opportunity in Malta, we would love to hear from you. Apply today!
